Name: Aredjay's Cool-Colored Grass
Author: Aredjay
Description:
This mod is a pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. See beautiful grass variations with seasons, and choose which ones to use with Paint Bucket and Paint Brush (Alternative Textures tools). You can then use them to create patterns if you like, or make themed patches of grass for decorating purposes. Or don't use tools and just enjoy the randomness.

This pack contains variations for spring, summer, and fall.

Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url] for the first part of the description because it says everything that needs to be said.) 

Also, the trees that are in the screenshots are from a world recolor called starblue valley. They are not because of this mod!

Have a nice day :)

Downloads.Description: Added and finished the summer grass. It is now entirely customly recolored.
